name: freq_shift
author: coldsoldr
description: Frequency shifter and ring modulator after Mutable Instruments Warps (Emilie Gillet, MIT): te-op1-cfw's fixed-point port (ports/fx/src/shift, the hundekraft kennel plugin freq_shift 0.2, at 5aa314b), MIT, conveyed under the GPL. Blue shift (-2 kHz .. 0 .. +2 kHz), green feedback (barber-pole), white spread (L up, R down), orange mix; fn + blue input gain on the wet path (-6 .. +6 dB, shift + fn + blue fine), green click shift / ring. Stereo at every position, a Hilbert pair per channel.
